h1: Eco-Friendly Playground Designs for Modern Outdoor Spaces

props.title: Eco-Friendly Playground Designs for Modern Outdoor Spaces
props.summaryText: Practical design features that make a playground greener without making it less fun: from nature-inspired structures and planting to permeable paths and solar lighting.
props.author: rohan-mehta
props.imageAlt: Wood texture of a tree trunk cross-section

takeaways.text: Eco-friendly design starts with layout: keep trees, minimise paving and plant generously.
Nature-inspired structures connect children with the natural world.
Permeable paths, drained surfaces and rain gardens manage monsoon water.
Solar lighting and durable, repairable equipment reduce running costs and waste.

faq.q: What are some eco-friendly playground design ideas?
faq.a: Keeping existing trees, adding native planting, using nature-inspired equipment, permeable paths, drained play surfaces, rain gardens, solar lighting, durable and repairable equipment, and natural play elements such as logs and sand.

faq.q: Is eco-friendly playground equipment more expensive?
faq.a: Not necessarily. Many eco-friendly choices are about layout and planting rather than special products. Durable equipment may cost more at first but lasts longer, which lowers the cost over its life.
